name: May
title: Where to go on holiday in May
intro: May is one of the best months to travel: Europe is warm, the summer crowds haven't arrived, and prices are lower than in July and August. Here's where's at its best.
seo_title: Where is hot in May? Early summer sun and where to go

faqs.question: Where is hot in May half term?
faqs.answer: Crete, Paphos, Malta and Gozo, Madeira and Cape Verde are all warm enough for the beach. The sea is still cooling off after winter, so a heated pool helps.

faqs.question: Where is good for a city break in May?
faqs.answer: Almost anywhere in Europe: Barcelona, Rome, Paris, Prague, Vienna, Copenhagen, Kraków and Berlin are all at their best, with long days and outdoor tables. Further away, try New York, Boston or Washington, D.C.

faqs.question: What about somewhere further away in May?
faqs.answer: Jordan, Namibia, the Galápagos and Bali are all good in May. In the US, the Grand Canyon is warm without the summer heat.
